watch_products.description: Every interval: run each product's searches on each store (ebay.search_products, amazon.search_products in the watcher's own background tab per store), match offers against the product rules, alert on NEW / PRICE DROP / BACK IN STOCK / NOW MATCHES, and write the cross-store comparison (compare.json, dashboard.html).
steps: Open one tab per store (once) and run that store module's preflight for search_products; reuse the tab afterwards with background loads.
For each product and store: search each query cheapest-first in [min, max]; normalize offers; diff against state.json.
Alert (sound + toast) on events after the baseline cycle; write alerts.jsonl, state.json, compare.json, dashboard.html.
Sleep interval_minutes (>= 5). On exit close the watcher's own tabs.
watch_products.evidence: state.json cycles increments; every product has a comparison entry; each alert names store, total, url and is logged in alerts.jsonl.
